title: Panpsychism vs. Cosmopsychism
content_html:
Panpsychism & Cosmopsychism

The Spectrum

Materialism ➝ Neutral Monism ➝ Panpsychism ➝ Cosmopsychism ➝ Absolute Idealism

Left → right increases the mental aspect treated as fundamental.
Middle positions (panpsychism/cosmopsychism) treat consciousness as basic while retaining the physical world’s reality.

Panpsychism

  • Consciousness or proto-experience is ubiquitous in the physical world.
  • Complex minds arise by integration of simpler experiential units (constitutive versions).
  • Motivation: addresses the hard problem by denying emergence ex nihilo.

Cosmopsychism

  • The universe as a whole is the fundamental subject of experience.
  • Individual minds are aspects or derivations of the cosmic mind (top‑down decomposition).
  • Motivation: avoids the combination problem faced by panpsychism.

Explanatory Targets & Open Problems

Issue Panpsychism Cosmopsychism Notes
Hard problem (why experience?) Treats experience as fundamental. Also fundamental (at cosmic level). Both reject “strong emergence.”
Unity of consciousness Combination problem: how do many micro-experiences form a single subject? Starts with unity; faces a decomposition problem (how one becomes many). Different symmetry-breaking stories proposed.
Empirical contact Compatible with neuroscientific correlates (IIT, etc.) but doesn’t predict them uniquely. Likewise compatible; testability hinges on bridge principles. Both need
psycho-physical laws linking mind & matter.
Parsimony Charges of “overpopulating” the world with minds. Charges of inflation at cosmic scale. Proponents argue parsimony of principle vs. ontology.
